sources.game: Read from the installed game files for this build: Data\Game2.dcb records, Data\Localization\english\global.ini, and the solar-system object containers (.socpak) in Data.p4k.

_meta.lookup: Keys are codes exactly as Game.log prints them: quantum targets ("selected point <CODE>"), inventory locations ("Location[<CODE>]"), route start names ("Projected Start Location is <name>"), refinery-notice station names, and planet names from terrain lines. `place` is shared by every code that means the same place; it is null when a code cannot be pinned to one place, and then `candidates` lists the possibilities when they are known. Codes built at runtime ("<record>_<entity id>") are not keys: match them against `patterns`, longest prefix first.
